text: August 21, 2025 - Article has been updated to reflect changes to the contact section Top talent to make vision-based autonomy practical, powerful, and accessible for farmers everywhere SAN JOSE, CA / ACCESS Newswire / August 21, 2025 / Bonsai Robotics Inc. ("Bonsai"), the leader in AI-first, vision-based autonomy software for agriculture, today introduces its expanded executive team - an experienced group of leaders with deep expertise spanning agriculture, robotics, artificial intelligence, and engineering - to deliver the next generation of intelligent, easy-to-use farm machines. Bonsai's vision is grounded in a core belief: autonomy in agriculture must evolve beyond narrow point solutions toward robust, end-to-end systems that tackle the labor, cost, and efficiency challenges growers face today. By integrating its state-of-the-art AI and computer vision models into existing equipment or its next generation machines, Bonsai is building a platform that enables consistent, real-world performance across crops, tasks, and terrain without burdening farmers with the complexity of robotics. "We're transforming the industry from iron to software, and that requires a first-in-class leadership team," said Tyler Niday, co-founder and CEO. "This new team unlocks the opportunity to design, build, and deploy the next generation of machines - built AI-first, field-tested, and ready for real-world agriculture." A Seasoned Team with a Track Record of Transformation The team has already demonstrated strong results in high-value specialty crops, delivering tools that address real labor shortages, improve consistency, and reduce cost per acre. With its unified vision and proven track record, Bonsai is well-positioned to lead the next era of agricultural automation. - Tyler Niday, Co-Founder & CEO Former engineering leader at Blue River and John Deere. - Ugur Oezdemir, Co-Founder & CTO Vision-based autonomy leader at Airbus, Blue River, and John Deere. - John Teeple, Chief Operating Officer Former Director of Technology at John Deere; launched Deere Labs and led precision ag strategy. - Matt Pigeon, Chief Financial Officer Veteran financial leader with experience at Sientra, Inogen, and Bexson Biomedical. - Gary Bradski, Chief Science Officer Founder of OpenCV; a pioneer in computer vision and real-time machine perception. - Brendan Dowdle, Chief Business Officer Former CEO of farm-ng; now leading commercial strategy and operations. - Arlen Frew, Chief Revenue Officer Go to market executive with 20+ years of experience at Akamai, Zscaler, and other enterprise leaders.
title: Bonsai Robotics Announces Deep-Bench Leadership to Accelerate AI-First Autonomy for Agriculture
